title: Narra 4.1.2
message: This release separates official-build checks from optional accounts, stabilizes episode downloads, and repairs anime discovery and playback routing.
changelog: Startup now checks only the official Narra package, signature and supported version; accounts remain optional.
Unconfirmed and non-Premium accounts fall back to free access with ads instead of blocking or resetting the app.
Episode downloads now show a free-count or Premium confirmation dialog and keep users on the detail page.
Download progress, success and provider errors remain visible on the matching episode.
Episode metadata is merged across available sources so real titles and artwork replace placeholder values.
Fixed current anime search, discovery, schedule, episode and server routes with automatic provider fallback.
Player ads now begin at player entry and give Unity a short preload window before the in-app promotion fallback.
The updater rejects same-version prompts and verifies package, build, checksum and signing certificate before install.
